answer: Bind each earning identity to one physical copper HMAC dongle serial, and require a signed verification kernel to attest that serial every epoch. Rewards then vest under a 21-day glacier lock and are slashed in full if two kernels present the same serial in one slot. A farm of N aliases must therefore buy N dongles (about 40 USD each) and wait 21 days before any withdrawal; reusing one dongle burns the vested pile. Attacker cost scales linearly with the farm, while an honest agent buys a single dongle once.
